title: Fix the failing test in a git repo and commit

turns.prompt: {D}/slugkit is a git repository with one failing unit test (run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`). Fix the bug in the package code (not the tests) and commit the fix with a commit message that starts with `fix:`. Do not push. Tell me the commit hash.
turns.verify: cd {D}/slugkit && out=$(python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -3); n=$(git log --oneline | wc -l); msg=$(git log -1 --pretty=%s); dirty=$(git status --porcelain | wc -l); echo "SHOW commits=$n last='$msg' dirty=$dirty tests=$out"; if echo "$out" | grep -q '^OK' && [ $n -ge 2 ] && echo "$msg" | grep -qi '^fix' && [ $dirty -eq 0 ]; then echo PASS; else echo "FAIL: commits=$n msg='$msg' dirty=$dirty"; fi
